headlines.title: 输掉AI竞赛也在所不惜？特朗普政府酝酿半导体新关税
headlines.summary: 据8名知情人士向POLITICO透露，特朗普政府正在考虑新一轮大规模半导体关税。尽管科技企业警告称，此举可能让美国主导人工智能领域的希望落空，但政府仍在权衡相关方案。知情人士表示，正在考虑的一种关税方案将大幅扩大受关税影响的科技产品范围，不仅包括芯片，还可能波及许多使用芯片的产品，例如笔记本电脑、游戏机以及数据中心使用的服务器。其中四位知情人士称，美国商务部长卢特尼克倾向于将外国公司享受关税减免与投资美国芯片制造业挂钩，以刺激国内芯片生产。

headlines.title_en: Semiconductor tariffs brewing in Trump admin even if it means losing the AI race
headlines.summary_en: The Trump administration is considering a new round of sweeping semiconductor tariffs, according to eight people familiar with the matter told POLITICO, weighing options that could undercut tech industry warnings that such a move would dash U.S. hopes of dominating artificial intelligence. One tariff option under consideration would significantly expand the scope of tech products affected, covering not just chips but potentially many products that use them, such as laptops, game consoles and servers used in data centers. Four of the people said Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is inclined to tie tariff relief for foreign companies to investment in U.S. chip manufacturing, to spur domestic chip production.

headlines.title: 中国互联网金融协会拟筹备成立征信工作委员会

headlines.title_en: National Internet Finance Association of China plans to set up a credit reporting working committee
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the National Internet Finance Association of China held a credit reporting self-regulation work symposium in Beijing. The meeting heard the association's work arrangements on preparing to establish a credit reporting working committee, strengthening risk prevention and governance, carrying out self-regulatory evaluations of industry institutions, and standardizing industry practitioner behavior. The PBOC Beijing Branch required credit reporting institutions under its jurisdiction to implement the spirit of the head office's documents, comply with credit reporting industry self-regulation management regulations, further enhance law-abiding and compliance awareness, and strengthen prudent operation capabilities. Participants engaged in in-depth discussions on the current operating situation and development prospects of the credit reporting industry and offered opinions and suggestions on credit reporting self-regulation work.

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei attends the 15th China Payment Clearing Forum
headlines.summary_en: On August 27, Lu Lei, member of the PBOC Party Committee and Deputy Governor, attended and delivered a speech at the 15th China Payment and Clearing Forum. headlines.title: 湖北：全面建成武汉多式联运服务中心 实现“铁水公空仓邮”数据交互贯通
headlines.summary: 湖北省人民政府办公厅印发《湖北省实施多式联运攻坚打通堵点卡点实施方案（2026—2030年）》。方案提出，力争到2030年，推动30个左右省级主要货运节点多式联运功能升级改造，主要港口铁路进港率保持100%。全面建成武汉多式联运服务中心，实现“铁水公空仓邮”数据交互贯通。港口集装箱铁水联运量年均增长10%左右，保持全国内河领先地位，“一单制”铁水联运集装箱量占比超过30%。培育5家具有跨区域联通和全过程管控能力的多式联运经营人和综合物流集成商。社会物流总费用占GDP比率下降至12%左右，建成全国多式联运标杆省份。（湖北省人民政府）

headlines.title_en: Hubei: Fully completes Wuhan multimodal transport service center, achieving data interoperability across rail, water, road, air, warehouse and postal systems
headlines.summary_en: The General Office of the Hubei Provincial People's Government issued the Implementation Plan for Hubei Province's Multimodal Transport Attack to Remove Bottlenecks and Blockages (2026–2030). The plan proposes to strive by 2030 to upgrade the multimodal transport functions of about 30 major provincial-level freight nodes, maintaining a 100% rail access rate at major ports. A Wuhan Multimodal Transport Service Center will be fully completed, achieving interconnected data exchange across rail, water, road, air, warehousing and postal services. Port container rail-water intermodal transport volume will grow by about 10% annually, maintaining a leading position among inland rivers nationwide, with 'one-order' rail-water intermodal container volume accounting for over 30%. Five multimodal transport operators and comprehensive logistics integrators with cross-regional connectivity and full-process control capability will be cultivated. The ratio of total social logistics costs to GDP will fall to about 12%, building Hubei into a national benchmark province for multimodal transport. (Hubei Provincial People's Government)

headlines.title: 中国太保：2026年上半年净利润307.75亿元，同比增长10.4%
headlines.summary: 中国太保公告，2026年上半年营业收入2121.36亿元，同比增长5.8%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润307.75亿元，同比增长10.4%，2025年同期为278.85亿元；扣除非经常性损益的净利润297.84亿元，同比增长13.6%。公司拟按总股本96.2亿股，每股派发现金股利0.42元（含税），共计分配40.41亿元。

headlines.title_en: CPIC: Net profit of 30.775 billion yuan in H1 2026, up 10.4% year on year
headlines.summary_en: CPIC announced that revenue for the first half of 2026 was RMB 212.136 billion, up 5.8% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 30.775 billion, up 10.4%, compared with RMB 27.885 billion in the same period of 2025; net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 29.784 billion, up 13.6%. The company plans to distribute a cash dividend of RMB 0.42 per share (tax inclusive) based on total share capital of 9.62 billion shares, totaling RMB 4.041 billion.

headlines.title: 南向资金今日净买入31.8亿元
headlines.summary: 南向资金今日净买入31.8亿元。港股通（沪）方面，小米集团-W、分别获净买入6.46亿港元、6.21亿港元；智谱净卖出额居首，金额为5.37亿港元；港股通（深）方面，腾讯控股、华虹宏力分别获净买入4.47亿港元、3.54亿港元；小米集团-W净卖出额居首，金额为1.54亿港元。

headlines.title_en: Southbound capital net bought 3.18 billion yuan today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital recorded net buying of RMB 3.18 billion today. On the Stock Connect (Shanghai) side, Xiaomi Corporation-W and [another stock] received net buying of HKD 646 million and HKD 621 million respectively; Zhipu saw the largest net selling, amounting to HKD 537 million. On the Stock Connect (Shenzhen) side, Tencent Holdings and Hua Hong Semiconductor received net buying of HKD 447 million and HKD 354 million respectively; Xiaomi Corporation-W saw the largest net selling of HKD 154 million.

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Automakers should report self-inspection results by end of December 2026; actively recall if defects are found
headlines.summary_en: The General Offices of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and three other departments issued a notice on carrying out a special action for production consistency and quality improvement of road motor vehicle products. The notice requires organizing enterprises to conduct self-inspection and rectification. Local MIIT authorities should organize key local road motor vehicle manufacturers to conduct comprehensive self-inspection and rectification against access management requirements and key rectification issues, systematically identifying problems in product production consistency, reliability, durability and new technology testing and verification of both enterprises themselves and key component suppliers, earnestly completing rectification work, comprehensively strengthening supply chain management, and enhancing production consistency assurance capability. Enterprises should submit self-inspection and rectification reports to local MIIT authorities by the end of December 2026. For discovered defects, enterprises should promptly file recall plans with the State Administration for Market Regulation and proactively implement recalls. headlines.title_en: Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission issues application guide for 2026 key technology R&D program 'Smart Computing Optical Network' new-generation optical communication technology projects; approved projects set milestone indicators, with 40% of fiscal funding released at launch and another 40% after meeting milestones
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission released the application guide for the 'Smart Computing Optical Network' new-generation optical communication technology project under the 2026 key technology R&D plan. Projects approved through review are set with milestone indicators: 40% of fiscal funding is disbursed at project start, 40% upon completing milestone indicators, and 20% upon completing all assessment indicators.

headlines.title: 宁沪高速：2026年上半年净利润25.03亿元，同比增长3.28%
headlines.summary: 宁沪高速公告，2026年上半年营业收入92.93亿元，同比下降1.20%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润25.03亿元，同比增长3.28%，2025年同期为24.24亿元；扣除非经常性损益的净利润24.88亿元，同比增长3.38%。公司拟以总股本50.38亿股为基数，每股派发现金股息人民币0.25元（含税），预计于2026年12月31日前派付。

headlines.title_en: Jiangsu Expressway: Net profit of 2.503 billion yuan in H1 2026, up 3.28% year on year
headlines.summary_en: Jiangsu Expressway announced that revenue for the first half of 2026 was RMB 9.293 billion, down 1.20% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was RMB 2.503 billion, up 3.28%, compared with RMB 2.424 billion in the same period of 2025; net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 2.488 billion, up 3.38%. The company plans to distribute a cash dividend of RMB 0.25 per share (tax inclusive) based on total share capital of 5.038 billion shares, expected to be paid before December 31, 2026.

headlines.title: 新华保险副总裁：银保渠道已成为驱动公司规模、价值协同增长的重要引擎
headlines.summary: 新华保险副总裁王练文在该公司2026年中期业绩发布会上表示，金融监管总局发布的65号文（即《关于进一步加强银行代理渠道费用管理有关事项的通知》）作为银保渠道“报行合一”政策向纵深推进的标志性文件，以费用精细化管理为抓手，压实各环节经营责任，关注银代渠道费用支出的真实性、合规性，旨在促进银行保险市场竞争更加规范有序。

headlines.title_en: NCI Vice President: Bancassurance Channel Has Become Key Engine Driving Company Scale and Value Growth
headlines.summary_en: Wang Lianwen, Vice President of New China Life, said at the company's 2026 interim results conference that Document No. 65 issued by the National Financial Regulatory Administration (i.e., the Notice on Further Strengthening Fee Management for Bank Agency Channels) serves as a landmark document advancing the 'reporting and implementation consistency' policy to a deeper stage in the bancassurance channel. Taking refined fee management as a starting point, it tightens operational responsibilities at each link and focuses on the authenticity and compliance of bancassurance channel fee expenditures, aiming to promote more standardized and orderly competition in the bank insurance market.
